31:2: These are the verses of the wise Book.
31:3: A guidance and mercy for the doers of good.
31:4: They establish salah, give zakat, and they firmly believe in the Hereafter.
31:5: Those are upon guidance from their Rabb, and those are the successful ones.
31:6: And among people are those who purchase idle talk to lead astray from the path of Allah without knowledge and to take it in ridicule. For those, there is a humiliating punishment.
31:7: When Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he did not hear them, as if there were a heaviness in his ears.
31:8: Indeed, for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there are gardens of Naim.
31:9: They will abide therein eternally, it is the true promise of Allah, He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
31:10: He created the heavens without pillars that you see. He placed firm mountains on the earth lest it shake with you, and dispersed therein every kind of living creature. We sent down water from the sky, thus We caused to grow therein every noble pair.
31:11: This is the creation of Allah. Show Me what those besides Him have created. Nay, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
31:12: And indeed, We gave Luqman wisdom: 'Give thanks to Allah.' And whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own soul. And whoever is ungrateful, indeed Allah is Rich (Free of need), Praiseworthy.
31:13: When Luqman said to his son while admonishing him: 'O my little son, do not associate partners with Allah. Indeed, associating partners is surely a great injustice.'
31:14: We enjoined upon man his parents. His mother bore him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Give thanks to Me and to your parents; to Me is the destination.
31:15: If they strive with you to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them, and accompany them in this world with kindness, and follow the path of him who turns to Me; then to Me is your return, and I will inform you of what you used to do.
31:16: O my little son, indeed, if it should be the weight of a mustard seed and be inside a rock or in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is al-Latif, All-Aware.
31:17: O my little son, establish salah, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over whatever befalls you; indeed, this is of the steadfastness of affairs.
31:18: And do not turn your face away from people and do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not love anyone conceited, boastful.
31:19: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice. Indeed, the most repulsive of voices is surely the voice of donkeys.
31:20: Did you not see that Allah subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and amply bestowed upon you His favors, open and hidden? And among people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge, without guidance, and without an illuminating book.
31:21: When it is said to them, 'Follow what Allah has sent down,' they say, 'Nay, we follow that upon which we found our fathers.' Even if Satan were calling them to the punishment of the blaze?
31:22: Whoever submits his face to Allah while doing good, he has indeed grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah is the outcome of all affairs.
31:23: Whoever disbelieves, let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, then We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knower of the essence of the breasts.
31:24: We grant them enjoyment for a little, then We drag them into a severe punishment.
31:25: And if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely say, 'Allah.' Say: 'All praise is to Allah.' Rather, most of them do not know.
31:26: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed Allah, He is al-Ghaniyy (Free of all need), the Praiseworthy.
31:27: And if all the trees on the earth were pens and the sea replenished after it with seven more seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
31:28: Your creation and your resurrection are only like a single soul. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
31:29: Did you not see that Allah merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night, and subjected the sun and the moon, each running until a specified term, and that indeed Allah is All-Aware of what you do?
31:30: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that what they call upon besides Him is falsehood, and indeed Allah is al-Aliyy, al-Kabir.
31:31: Did you not see that the ships run through the sea by the favor of Allah? That is so He may show you of His signs. Indeed in that, there are surely signs for everyone who is very patient, very grateful.
31:32: When a wave covers them like shadows, they call upon Allah, making religion purely for Him. Then when He delivers them to the land, some of them keep to the middle course. And none denies Our signs except every traitor and ungrateful one.
31:33: O people! Fear your Rabb and dread a day when a father cannot avail his child anything, nor can a child avail his father anything. Indeed, the promise of Allah is true. So let not the worldly life deceive you, and let not the deceiver deceive you concerning Allah.
31:34: Indeed, knowledge of the Hour is with Allah, and He sends down the rain, and He knows what is in the wombs, and no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in which land it will die; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
